# Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct

## Our pledge

We pledge to make participation in this project a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, disability, ethnicity, sex characteristics, gender identity and expression, level of experience, education, socioeconomic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Our standards

Examples of acceptable behavior include:

- Demonstrating empathy and respect
- Giving and accepting constructive feedback
- Focusing on what is best for the project and its community
- Taking responsibility for mistakes

Examples of unacceptable behavior include:

- Harassment, insults, or discriminatory comments
- Publishing another person's private information without permission
- Sharing credentials, account data, or sensitive local files
- Disruptive or deliberately hostile conduct

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may remove, edit, or reject comments, commits, code, issues, and other contributions that do not align with this code of conduct. Serious or repeated violations may result in a temporary or permanent ban from project spaces.

Reports should be made privately through the contact method listed on the repository owner's GitHub profile. Reports will be reviewed and investigated promptly and fairly.

## Attribution

This code of conduct is adapted from the Contributor Covenant, version 2.1.
